reply_text:
I replied to Pree in our DM with the Marrow Fieldworks tickets. I found three likely ones and one possible one:

- **#4409**: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. It's in Moss's "Central handoffs next week" digest from 2 Jan 2026.
- **#4412**: a driver text-message prompt glitch when staging combine trailers. It's in the same Moss digest.
- **PD-5302**: a follow-up from this week. Hollis posted it in #central-random on 14 Oct.
- **#8841 (possible)**: West yard Door 2 double-booking. Tobias posted it in #central-random on 13 Oct for "Tobias's dealer account" but didn't name Marrow Fieldworks, so I asked Pree to check it.

I'm not fully sure about #4409 and #4412 either. Moss's digest lists them as "Pree's dealer account" just under the Marrow Fieldworks handoff line, but never names the account next to the tickets. I described them to Pree as pre-handoff items but didn't spell out that doubt.

I left out tickets for other accounts and told Pree why: FR-882 and PD-4821 are for Marrow Agrisupply, and #88412 is for Tansleigh Packaging.

Sources: I only checked places Pree can see herself:
- Her channels: #central-random and #central-team. I took "this week's chat" to mean this week's messages in #central-random.
- Our DM.
- Moss's public files.

I didn't use message search. Moss's other notes don't mention Marrow Fieldworks tickets. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed.
